fluff.overview: Lyran military budgets translate directly into infantry equipment quality, giving LCAF conventional forces a material edge that compensates for the uneven tactical leadership the social general tradition sometimes produces. Jump infantry use thruster backpacks to leap across obstacles and reposition rapidly on the battlefield, trading platoon size for the tactical mobility to seize or defend terrain that foot troops cannot reach quickly. Armed with assault rifles and Grand Mauler infantry gauss cannons, these platoons field some of the hardest-hitting crew-served weapons available to conventional infantry, capable of threatening armored vehicles at extended range.
